scope: Read-only full-export pattern scans, including metadata and nested JSON strings to three decoding levels.
Targeted masked-context review of distinct quoted credential/token values and bearer-like words.
Matched repeated published fixture password against pinned Stage 1 specification; reviewed local synthetic/negative test provenance by public tool-call context.
Bounded personal-data labels, shared-memory marker, email-domain and local-project path checks; no unrelated project names observed.

bearer_prose_false_positives.classification: Ordinary prose following the word bearer, not an Authorization header or session token.

expected_nonsecret_content: Synthetic application fixture/test account values and invalid-token test inputs
Participant names/handles, Git authorship email, room/event identifiers
Local workspace/tool paths and application code/public tool activity
limitations: No raw credential values, credentials files, hidden reasoning or participant private account stores were opened or reproduced in this report.
Generic environment-assignment detection was not treated as credential proof because source code is embedded in the room. Quoted security-related literals were separately reviewed.
Pattern and bounded context checks cannot prove absence of every secret, arbitrary private narrative, encoded/encrypted secret or content outside the export.
No external service validated candidate values; no network, model, application test, redaction or export mutation occurred.
This review supports preserving the unchanged artifact in the intended private repository only; it is not approval for public publication or final submission.
